text:
Marya H: Heads-up — saw a regression after the kernel-selector rollout (chooser-v3) on runtime-prod around 03:40 UTC. Token-level tail latency up, and KV prefix cache hit rate dropped noticeably. Evictions spiked.

Kai Zhang: same here. hp-search route shows hitrate ~86% -> ~62% over the last 10m, requests with large prefixes affected most. 99th token latency increased ~35ms.

Devon L: perf-bot snapshot attached in monitoring channel but TL;DR: kv_cache_requests_total ↑, kv_cache_hits_total flat, kv_cache_evictions_total spike. Possible kernel change increased memory per-kv-entry or altered reuse pattern.

perf-bot: Metric snapshot: 
```
# per-route hitrate
sum by (route) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))

# evictions
sum by (route) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
```

Anita S: Could also be that chooser-v3 prefers kernel-x that batches differently, shifting JIT/kernel memory layout and causing more frequent compact/evict cycles. We should check per-kernel memory allocs and KV shard footprint.

Marya H: @Kai @Devon can we quickly diff canary vs prod? I only rolled the selector to 60% yesterday. If we can pin a small pool back to chooser-v2 we can compare hit curves. Tagging @oncall in case we need a rollback. :warning:

Kai Zhang: I'll add panels to Grafana: 1) per-route prefix reuse histogram 2) eviction-by-entry-size 3) token-latency breakdown by cache_hit label. Suggested PromQL for token latency panel: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, cache_hit))
```

Devon L: Quick mitigation experiment plan: bump KV shard cache size by 10% on a single backing pool and run prefix-heavy load. Load command: 
```
./tools/loadgen --scenario=prefix-heavy --routes=hp-search,chat --qps=2000 --duration=10m
```
I'll kick that off on pool-3 and collect traces.

Anita S: Also want a low-effort instrumentation change: add label `selected_kernel` to `kv_cache_request_total` so we can attribute hit/miss/eviction by kernel selection. I'll open a PR for runtime to emit that.

Devon L: opened PR to revert default to chooser-v2 on the rollout flag and to add the metric: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2981 (WIP). Putting a canary rollback option behind flag.

perf-bot: New trace for sample request id=trc_0x9f34 logged; latency breakdown attached to the trace (shows cache_miss path dominated).

Marya H: Thanks — plan for the next hour: (1) Kai adds panels and shares link, (2) Devon runs load test on pool-3, (3) Anita lands metric PR, (4) revert flag if pool-3 proves better. If rollback, coordinate with @deploy-bot to schedule a quick canary redeploy.

deploy-bot: Noted. If revert is requested, I can schedule a canary redeploy to the affected fleet. Use `/deploy canary runtime chooser-v2` to kick off. :white_check_mark:

Kai Zhang: I'll post the dashboard links in this thread when ready. For visibility, creating a short incident note in incidents/ if we end up rolling back.

Marya H: Great. Keep updates short here. If anyone sees production errors beyond perf (5xxs), call it out immediately. :phone:
